old_caption:
The video showcases a sequence where a series of colorful dominoes are arranged in a zigzag pattern on a wooden floor. The dominoes are organized into four distinct rows, each row featuring a different color: blue, orange, red, and green. The arrangement is meticulous, with each domino placed precisely to form a continuous line across the floor.

The scene is static except for the falling dominoes; the dominoes in the red row begin to fall sequentially from right to left, and the falling stops at the red row.
original_wisa_caption:
The video showcases a sequence where a series of colorful dominoes are arranged in a zigzag pattern on a wooden floor. The dominoes are organized into four distinct rows, each row featuring a different color: blue, orange, red, and green. The arrangement is meticulous, with each domino placed precisely to form a continuous line across the floor.

As the video progresses, the dominoes begin to fall in a chain reaction. Starting from the left side of the frame, the dominoes at the end of each row sequentially topple over, creating a wave-like effect as they cascade down the zigzag path. The falling dominoes cause a ripple effect, with each falling piece knocking over the next in its row, and occasionally, pieces from adjacent rows also fall due to the momentum.

The scene captures the dynamic movement of the dominoes, highlighting the physics of the chain reaction. The wooden floor beneath provides a neutral background that contrasts with the vibrant colors of the dom
caption: The video showcases a wooden floor laid out with several parallel domino runs, each a line of blue-based pieces topped with a single color. Curved blue connectors join the runs into a serpentine path. A loose scatter of flat green dominoes sits above them, and the camera remains fixed throughout. At the start the upper orange-topped run is already mostly toppled, and only a few upright orange pieces remain at its far left. These lean and fall flat within the first moments, after which that run stays still. Meanwhile the red-topped run, fully upright at first, begins to tilt at its left end, and a falling front travels steadily left-to-right along its length, while the bottom orange run and the top green scatter show no change. As the red front reaches the right-hand curve, the green-topped run below it starts toppling from its right end, the fall propagating right-to-left, so that by the last frame only the rightmost green pieces are down.
